name: PdfCraft
description: PdfCraft is an open-source PDF reader and editor written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team, for reading, organizing and protecting PDFs. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.10.1 landed in October 2026.

zh.description: PdfCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源 PDF 阅读与编辑工具，用于阅读、整理和保护 PDF。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.10.1 于 2026 年 10 月发布。

body.en: PdfCraft is the ArtCraft family's open-source PDF reader and editor, written from scratch in pure Rust — for reading, organizing and protecting PDFs.
body.zh: PdfCraft 是 ArtCraft 家族的开源 PDF 阅读与编辑工具，从零开始用纯 Rust 编写——用于阅读、整理和保护 PDF。

body.en: It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) alongside Windows and Linux builds. Development moves fast — v0.10.1 landed in October 2026.
body.zh: macOS 提供 universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时有 Windows 和 Linux 构建。迭代很快——v0.10.1 于 2026 年 10 月发布。
